title: TailBooster: A Dual-Layer Generative Framework for Extreme Value Augmentation with Operational Validity Enforcement
abstract: arXiv:2608.11951v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Extreme events in air transport, such as severe arrival delays and abnormal air times, cause cascading network disruptions with substantial operational, economic, and safety costs. Such events are rare in historical records, leaving insufficient training signal for machine learning models. Synthetic data augmentation offers a principled solution, but conventional generative models under-represent distributional tails and give no guarantee against operationally infeasible instances, such as a short air time paired with a long flight distance. No existing approach addresses both limitations for mixed-type tabular records. We propose TailBooster, a dual-layer generative framework combining generative modelling with two anomaly detection layers. translated_title: TailBooster：一种具有运行有效性约束的极端值增强双层生成框架
translated_abstract: （续）用于识别并拒绝运行不可行的生成实例，确保输出符合操作约束。在真实航空数据集上的实验表明，TailBooster显著提升了极端事件预测的召回率和精度，同时保持了运行有效性，优于现有基线方法。
tldr: TailBooster提出了一种结合统计极端值提取与深度学习异常检测的双层生成框架，专门用于增强航空运输中的极端事件数据，同时确保生成实例的运行可行性。
en_tdlr: TailBooster proposes a dual-layer generative framework combining statistical extreme-value extraction with deep anomaly detection to augment rare extreme events in air transport while enforcing operational validity of generated instances.
